Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme, and let <MATH_0002> be an algebraic space over <MATH_0003>.
Let <MATH_0004> be a pre-relation in algebraic spaces over <MATH_0005>.
If a categorical quotient in the category of algebraic spaces
over <MATH_0006> exists, then it is unique up to unique isomorphism.
Similarly for categorical quotients in full subcategories of
<MATH_0007>.
